detail.title: Intex 6.5 KG Semi-Automatic Washing Machine (Red & White) - SA65RDPT
detail.overview: This semi-automatic 6.5kg washing machine from Intex has a separate washer and dryer to save water. It has a magic filter to effectively trap dust and dirt. You can adjust the water being used through a slider and the design is completely packed for protecting the wires. It has an anti-corrosive rust-free body and the temperature overload protection technology that protects the motor from high temperatures. This washing machine spins the clothes silently and has a 5-year warranty on the motor.
features: Semi-automatic Machine with Separate Washer and Dryer to Save Water
Magic filter to effectively trap dust and dirt
Noise free spinning for silent wash
Rat Away technology: Completely packed design for protection of wiring
2 Wash Programmes for better cleaning with Lint filter & Buzzer
Powerful Motor with Temperature Overload Protection (TOP) Technology
